modules.name: organizations-and-people
modules.purpose: Durable actors and separately attributed temporal assertions.

modules.name: products-and-commerce
modules.purpose: Product identity and source-backed package or menu label versions.

modules.name: diagnostics-and-biomarkers
modules.purpose: Orderable tests, measurement definitions and exact assay procedures.

modules.name: studies-and-evidence
modules.purpose: Studies, propositions and attributed assertion occurrences.

modules.name: documents-and-provenance
modules.purpose: Source identity, immutable captures, evidence locators and retrieval projections.

node:Organization.description: A durable organization resolved by registry identifier, then normalized legal name and jurisdiction; a brand is a separate identity.

node:Person.description: A durable human identity; changing roles and affiliations are separate attributed assertions.

node:Assertion.description: A source-attributed occurrence linking subject, predicate, object or literal, asserter, locators and validity; preserve qualifiers and recorded time.

node:Product.description: A marketed product identity; product kind and branded identity are separate from laboratory test procedure and package label versions.

node:LabelVersion.description: One version of a package label or menu declaration, with source-backed composition and serving details; not a generic product snapshot.

node:LabTest.description: An orderable or purchasable laboratory test; panels are LabTests of kind PANEL with INCLUDES_TEST composition episodes. Resolve by issuer and test code, otherwise issuer and verbatim name.

node:Biomarker.description: A reusable biomarker definition kept distinct from a subject-specific measurement or an assay procedure.

node:Metric.description: A reusable reported measure or score definition kept distinct from an observed subject-specific value.

node:AssayVersion.description: The exact laboratory measurement procedure, instrument, software and specimen configuration; preserve NOT_REPORTED fields instead of guessing equivalence.

enum:MeasurementPlatform.description: Controlled measurement or algorithm input technology categories; absorbs the historical TechnologyPlatform concept as an enum, not a node.

node:Study.description: A bounded research investigation kept distinct from the assertions and evidence derived from it.

node:Claim.description: A proposition kept distinct from an Assertion occurrence attributing who stated it, when and on what evidence.

node:Source.description: Stable source endpoint identity by normalized canonical URI; a changed captured page is a new SourceSnapshot.

node:SourceSnapshot.description: An immutable captured Source version identified by source, content hash and retrieval time; retain capture completeness and content hash basis.

node:SourceLocator.description: An addressable evidence location within a captured source; keep locator identity distinct from retrieval chunks.

node:Chunk.description: A derived retrieval span of SourceSnapshot text. Never evidence, never a locator, never a mutation input; chunk writes are unsupported by this release.
